messages:
maria: Quick sync on follow-ups from the auth-provider + model-registry outage this morning. Want to lock owners and realistic timelines.
ops-bot: Created incident-2026-0502 (P2). Runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/incident/2026-0502 :spiral_note_pad:
sam: I'll summarize root cause in the postmortem doc, but short: vendor control-plane transient 500s -> our token refresh retrier overloaded registry, TTL fallback incorrect, and missing regional canaries.
lena: adding immediate priorities: stop retry storm (client-side), add registry-side circuit breaker, and vendor escalation + ask for postmortem.
oz: Owners/proposals: 
- ACTION-A1: client rate-limiter + exponential backoff (owner: lena, ETA: 2026-05-05, estimate: 10h)
- ACTION-A2: registry circuit-breaker + safe TTL override (owner: sam, ETA: 2026-05-12, estimate: 14h)
- ACTION-A3: multi-region canary for token refresh + model pull (owner: oz, PoC: 2026-05-04, rollout: 2026-05-18, estimate: 8h)
- ACTION-A4: vendor SLA escalation & request for control-plane mitigation (owner: kevin, ETA: 2026-05-10, notes: get on-call contact)
- ACTION-A5: CI regression that injects control-plane 5xx/429 into auth path (owner: lena, ETA: 2026-05-07, estimate: 6h)
kevin: +1 to all. I'll open a vendor ticket and request their control-plane incident timeline. Also recommend a quarterly joint drill with vendor.
sam: technical detail: registry TTL fallback was set to 0 on auth errors which triggered immediate renewals. Plan is to set a floor of 30s and exponential backoff at client. Will put a feature-flag to roll it gradually.
lena: CI snippet I'll add to the PR for ACTION-A5 (mock control-plane): ```# test auth retry under 5xx
with mock_server(5xx=True):
  resp = client.refresh_token()
  assert resp.status in {503, 429} or client.backoff_attempts > 0```
ops-bot: Linked incident to postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-05-auth-flash :link:
mar ia: On recurring patterns: ops shows 3 similar auth spikes in last 6 months during region maintenance windows. We should add a recurring "auth-path resilience" drill owned by ops-sre rotation, cadence: monthly. First drill target: 2026-05-20.
kevin: who owns tracking closure? propose weekly 20m triage until ACTION-A1/A2/A3 are closed. Owner: maria to run.
sam: I'll add ACTION-A2 to sprint 14 as high-priority. If anyone needs reshuffling, speak now.
olz: typo: that's oz, not olz :)
oz: noted :)
lena: small ask: can we make the client library emit metrics when it triggers circuit-breaker/backoff so alerts can show surfaced root cause quickly? owner: lena, ETA: 2026-05-06. (add as ACTION-A6)
maria: updating tracker now with actions and ETA's. Current tracker link: https://redwood.internal/trackers/pm-2026-0502 (internal only). Will tag platform-sre, devex, and infra.
kevin: vendor contact: I'll request durable escalation path and ask for a post-incident mitigation plan. Put correspondence in tracker (sensitive).
sam: question: do we need a DB migration for safe TTL?
sam: answer: no DB migration; it's a config + feature-flag rollout. We'll validate via canary.
oz: status updates: I'll post PoC logs in the tracker when done.
lena: ACTION-A1 hours: 10h, ACTION-A5 hours: 6h, ACTION-A6 hours: 3h.
sam: ACTION-A2 hours: 14h.
maria: weekly triage invites created (Mon 09:30 PT) until all high-priority actions are green. ops-bot: Reminder created: weekly-incident-triage every Mon 09:30 PT, invited: maria, sam, lena, oz, kevin.
sam: tagging @platform-sre in the tracker for rollout gating.
kevin: please react with :white_check_mark: when you confirm assigned hours/ETAs so we can close the loop.
maria: thanks team. I'll close thread after tracker is canonical and the triage invite is confirmed.
all: :white_check_mark:
